_comments.location: Azure region where the search service will be created
_comments.search_service_name: Name of the Azure Cognitive Search service
_comments.index_name: Name of the unified multilingual index
_comments.token_overlap: Overlap between chunks for context continuity
_comments.semantic_config_name: Name for the semantic search configuration
_comments.vector_config_name: Name for the vector search profile (remove to disable vector search)
_comments.languages: List of language codes to support (en, fr, etc.)
_comments.primary_language: Primary language used for vector embeddings
_comments.document_mapping_file: Path to JSON file mapping EN/FR document pairs
_comments.data_paths_multilingual: Base paths and URL prefixes for each language
